visual.name: navigationMenu
visual.description: Hierarchical page-navigation menu with collapsible groups, icons, active-state tracking, and JSON-filter integration. Optimised for OnePlan.ai, works with any Power BI report.

dataRoles.description: Display label for each menu entry (required).
dataRoles.name: menuItem

dataRoles.description: Parent section or category. Items sharing the same group value are nested under a collapsible header.
dataRoles.name: group

dataRoles.description: Target page display name, bookmark name, or any unique key. Written to a JSON filter on click so other visuals / buttons can react.
dataRoles.name: pageId

dataRoles.description: Icon keyword (home, chart, settings, folder, users, calendar, alert, check, star, target, clock, link). Leave empty for no icon.
dataRoles.name: iconName

dataRoles.description: Numeric value controlling display order (ascending). Items without a value sort alphabetically.
dataRoles.name: sortOrder
licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model

activePageId.description: Set this to the Page Identifier matching this page so the correct menu item is highlighted.

filterColumn.description: The column name in your model that receives the selected Page Identifier value via JSON filter.

filterTable.description: The table containing the filter column.

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.
